_readme: Catalogue routes that changed shape and must keep resolving.
ONE SOURCE, TWO CONSUMERS. src/data/category-aliases.ts reads this to emit the
browser-side redirect stub Next generates under output:'export', and
scripts/build-taxonomy-redirects.mjs reads it to write the real 301s in
deploy/nginx/taxonomy-redirects.conf. Before this file the nginx conf was
hand-maintained beside a hardcoded TypeScript table, which is two places for one
fact — the arrangement that silently drifts the first time somebody edits one.
categoryAliases: a whole category slug was retired. Everything under it moves.
productMoves: a single product changed category while BOTH categories stay live.
The second kind cannot be expressed as a category alias, because the old category
is not retired — only that one product left it.
productMerges: two records described ONE product and one of them was retired. The
old slug 301s to the survivor inside the same category. Distinct from productMoves,
where the product is fine and only its category changed — here the page itself is
gone because it should never have existed twice.
Never delete an entry. The old URL stays indexed for months and a removed entry
turns a 301 back into a 404, which is the thing this file exists to prevent.

productMoves.why: 美工 review 2026-09-02: 放回逃生锁类目. The photograph is a push-bar exit device with its strike and fixings; it was filed under hardware-accessories/latches, where no buyer shopping for a panic device would look.
美工 review 2026-09-02: 这个放在不锈钢拉手的类目. A recessed stainless flush pull, not a grip handle set.
美工 review 2026-09-02: 这个调回大拉手的类目. The set is an entrance handleset — grip handle, thumb latch and deadbolt together — so it belongs with the handlesets rather than among the bare deadbolt bodies.

productMerges.why: 同一根拉手两条记录。2026-09-14 按甲方「T2973A 去 union 爬取」去查，artunion 上没有 T2973A 这个型号（规格缓存里它的记录就是 search_id 无结果）。T2973 的详情页上一共四张图，其中尺寸图的文件名是 T2973AxD900SZoW.jpg —— 「A」是 UNION 给图纸文件的后缀，不是另一个型号。我们这边因此分成了两条：T2973 拿到三张照片、规格表空着，T2973A 拿到那张尺寸图、规格表是照 T2973 的 UNION 数据填的。三张照片与 UNION 的 D000/D400/D500 逐张比对，灰度平均差 1.3 / 2.8 / 2.9（满分 255），确认是同三张。幸存的是 T2973，因为那才是原厂型号号；名字用 T2973A 那条的「门拉手（可定制长度）」，与 UNION 规格表的「オーダー対応 L1600〜2200」一致。

同一个四圆柱锁体两条记录. Both are LC14, 85mm centre distance, 50mm backset, euro profile, four round bolts. The survivor carries eight photographs and the full spec table; the retired one carried a hero and four spec rows. Google reported 462 pages as 'duplicate, user has not selected canonical' — this is one of the pairs feeding it.
同一个 LC04 两条记录. Identical specs (85mm centre distance, 60mm backset, euro profile, four round bolts, wooden doors). The survivor carries six gallery photographs; the retired one carried a hero only.
